8d3c35f1d8.q: What are the four core components of an email funnel according to Email Empire methodology?
8d3c35f1d8.a: An email funnel has four pieces: a lead magnet that solves one specific problem so people happily give their email address; a nurture sequence of handful of emails that builds trust and shifts how subscribers think about their problem; a timed offer introduced when the subscriber is most ready with a killer deal to incentivize immediate purchase; and a pitch sequence that introduces the offer and overcomes subscriber objections. The funnel walks every new subscriber through the same path automatically whether you are at your desk, on vacation, or at a ball game.

b9f32484cf.q: Why does Allison Hardy recommend building an email funnel instead of relying on social media platforms?
b9f32484cf.a: You own your email list while Instagram followers, Facebook group members, and TikTok followers belong to platforms controlled by someone else. Algorithms change overnight, features disappear, and tools get shut down with a week's notice or overnight, causing unpredictable business hits. An email funnel lives in your email service provider and keeps working no matter what any app decides to do next—it is the closest thing to job security an entrepreneur gets.

29b1f203bd.q: How does an email funnel create predictable revenue compared to relying on live launches?
29b1f203bd.a: An email funnel smooths out the live launch roller coaster, which gives a big spike then a long scary dip. With an email funnel, new email subscribers come in daily, their nurture sequence nurtures them daily, and the pitch sequence sells daily. This creates predictable revenue which allows you to plan, hire, save, and breathe instead of depending on whether a reel took off or whether you have energy for another live launch.
